summary: All four files contain formal mathematical content with definitions, structures, and proofs relevant to morphological theory. Basic.lean defines paradigms, paradigm systems, and complexity measures. Contiguity.lean formalizes the *ABA generalization with contiguity predicates, feasible monotonicity, and three-cell pattern theorems. Morphome.lean defines morphomes as nontrivial unnatural syncretism classes with value-conjunction naturalness. UD.lean provides bidirectional translations between analytical features and Universal Dependencies tags with round-trip theorems. Every file has formal declarations (def, structure, theorem) with proofs; none are pure import aggregators, generated data, transcripts, or stubs.

summary: All six files contain formal mathematical content with definitions, structures, and theorems with proofs relevant to morphological theory. Gender.lean formalizes gender features, categorizer heads, and realization patterns with theorems like toSplitFeature_not_isHybrid and realizeGender_congr. Impoverishment.lean defines impoverishment rules, paradigmatic/syntagmatic distinction, and rule chains with chain_pointwise. Merger.lean formalizes successive-cyclic Merger, synthesis, and the Synthetic Superlative/Root Suppletion Generalizations. FeatureBundle.lean provides the spellout definition connecting Minimalist bundles to VI via the Subset Principle. Selection.lean implements Elsewhere and Minimize-Junk selection with plateau theorems. TreeSpellout.lean formalizes nanosyntax phrasal spellout with Superset Principle, Foot Condition, and Taraldsen matching. None are pure import aggregators, generated data, transcripts, or stubs.
